nodes.title: 《形而上学导论》(Einführung in die Metaphysik)
nodes.summary: This partial document provides information about different versions of the book "Introduction to Metaphysics" (《形而上学导论》). It highlights two main translations: the preferred new translation by Wang Qingjie published by the Commercial Press in 2015, and the older translation by Xiong Wei and Wang Qingjie included in the Chinese Translation Classics series. The document also includes links to a direct PDF download of the book and mentions that an online version is available on WeChat Reading.
